description:
Get the full module definition with stable IDs. The output is round-trippable — modify and send back via update_module. Use this when modifying a module to preserve IDs for renaming.

Modify workflow: list_modules → get_module_canvas → (apply changes) → validate_design → update_module.
Load resource inistate://schema/configure before modifying to know valid field types, colors, and actors.
Access rules (who can open the module, run activities, see fields) are not in this output: read them with get_module_access, change them with set_module_access.
When the module has scripts (the Python and JavaScript its designers wrote), the answer's scripts section lists each one with where it is, to read: explain what it does or why an entry came out as it did. Scripts are read-only: update_module never changes, adds or removes one on its own. A person changes a script in Studio, so tell the user what to change and where, and offer a formula or an automation instead when one can do the job.
The answer's versionId is the design version you read: send it back as update_module's baseVersion.
The answer's designActor says who may save AI design changes (ai: saves directly bar the always-human changes; human: a person approves every one), and pendingApproval names a change already waiting for a person: do not stack another edit on the module; tell the user it is waiting.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: get_module_canvas
